issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error scenarios or edge cases, limiting completeness.

scenarios.name: install-opentofu-macos
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric, while Response A fails to use the required commands and output format.

scenarios.name: configure-s3-backend-with-variables
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but uses a different variable name, while Response B fails to include the required use_lockfile setting and does not use the variable in the backend block.

scenarios.name: add-vpc-subnet-test
scenarios.rationale: Response B is closer to the rubric, providing the required HCL structure and assertion, though it misnames the file and run block; Response A fails to meet the rubric entirely.
